+/// Remove leftover legacy flat keys when `providers:` block already exists.
+fn cleanup_legacy_provider_keys(config: &mut Mapping) -> bool {
+    let configured_suffix = "_configured";
+    let mut changed = false;
+
+    let stale_keys: Vec<serde_yaml::Value> = config
+        .keys()
+        .filter(|k| {
+            k.as_str()
+                .map(|s| {
+                    s == "GOOSE_PROVIDER" || s == "GOOSE_MODEL" || s.ends_with(configured_suffix)
+                })
+                .unwrap_or(false)
+        })
+        .cloned()
+        .collect();
+
+    for key in stale_keys {
+        config.shift_remove(&key);
+        changed = true;
+    }
+
+    changed
+}
+
+/// Migrate flat provider keys to the structured `providers:` block.
+///
+/// Old layout (flat keys):
+/// ```yaml
+/// GOOSE_PROVIDER: claude-acp
+/// GOOSE_MODEL: current
+/// claude-acp_configured: true
+/// lmstudio_configured: true
+/// ```
+///
+/// New layout:
+/// ```yaml
+/// active_provider: claude-acp
+/// providers:
+///   claude-acp:
+///     enabled: true
+///     model: current
+///     configured: true
+///   lmstudio:
+///     enabled: true
+///     model: ""
+///     configured: true
+/// ```
+///
+fn migrate_provider_config(config: &mut Mapping) -> bool {
+    let providers_key = serde_yaml::Value::String(PROVIDERS_CONFIG_KEY.to_string());
+
+    // If providers block already exists, just clean up any leftover flat keys.
+    if config.contains_key(&providers_key) {
+        return cleanup_legacy_provider_keys(config);

discussion_comments.comment_body: Valid edge case. If a config has a providers: block (e.g., from partial manual editing) but no active_provider key, and still has a legacy GOOSE_PROVIDER flat key, the current code enters the cleanup branch at line 170 and deletes GOOSE_PROVIDER without first backfilling active_provider. This would lose the active selection. The fix is to check for and backfill active_provider from GOOSE_PROVIDER before cleanup. I'll add that to the cleanup path.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
`ConfigSettings.tsx:182` reads `typedConfig.GOOSE_PROVIDER` from the bulk `readAllConfig()` response, which calls `all_values()` on the raw YAML. After migration strips those keys, the UI gets empty string.

Fixed in 29a2b50: `all_values()` now injects the virtual keys by calling the existing `get_goose_provider()` / `get_goose_model()` getters, which synthesize the values from the structured `providers:` block. Persisted config stays clean while bulk reads remain backward-compatible.

The `else` branch creates a `ProviderEntry` with `model: ""` which overwrites any model that `set_provider_entry`'s write-path migration just moved into the structured block. Fix: read the active model via `get_goose_model()` before falling through to the else, so the entry preserves whatever was migrated.

Fixed in 2aa870a.
